subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: Should OpenClaw accept changing omitted Unix `killProcessTree` and `signalProcessTree` calls to leader-checked group kill while preserving explicit `detached:true` group cleanup for audited callers?
rationale: This is the right technical shape from source review, but it changes shared process-cleanup semantics and the remaining compatibility/availability tradeoff should be accepted by a maintainer before merge.

options.title: Accept the helper invariant
options.body: Merge after maintainer review, keeping omitted cleanup leader-checked and explicit `detached:true` only where the caller owns the spawn-time process-group fact.

options.title: Request broader live proof
options.body: Ask for additional macOS managed-gateway or Linux minimal-image proof before merging the shared helper change.

options.title: Replace with narrower caller-only repair
options.body: Reject the helper default change and require a different PR that only threads explicit detached state through selected callers.

recommendation.title: Accept the helper invariant
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer review, keeping omitted cleanup leader-checked and explicit `detached:true` only where the caller owns the spawn-time process-group fact.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history makes this the best available owner signal for the relocated process-tree helper.
